request: Invert final analyst CALL/PUT in oscillation/retracement conditions; preserve continuous one-direction movement.

ruleFrozenBeforeScoring.observedBars: Four completed 10-second quote bars ending at the last closed clock boundary; these are internal observation bars, not a guessed broker chart timeframe.
ruleFrozenBeforeScoring.mixed: Both positive and negative closed-bar body directions appear: invert.
ruleFrozenBeforeScoring.pullback: All nonflat closed bars share one direction, but last 6-second actual move is opposite: invert.
ruleFrozenBeforeScoring.preserve: Continuous one-sided movement, flat market, incomplete/stale observations, unsupported duration, no authorized base signal or already-inverted decision.
ruleFrozenBeforeScoring.location: Exactly once, after every final structural override and before the immutable signal lifecycle.

evaluation: All 15 known Forex and 18 known crypto windows plus one known video extraction. Every dataset has already been inspected: exploratory replay, not new independent validation. Same-entry counterfactual on all windows, plus full runtime equivalence checks on representative windows.
priorRelatedFailure: The older mixed-range-label-only inverse modestly improved known Forex but worsened the known video. This is a different explicit candle/pullback rule requested by the user, with no claim of prior success. No tuning after these results.
